name: Ex Works
risk_transfer_point: At the seller's premises or another named place, when the goods are placed at the buyer's disposal, not loaded

name: Free Carrier
risk_transfer_point: When the goods are handed to the buyer's carrier at the named place, loaded if that place is the seller's premises

name: Carriage Paid To
risk_transfer_point: When the goods are handed to the first carrier; the seller still pays carriage to the named destination

name: Carriage and Insurance Paid To
risk_transfer_point: When the goods are handed to the first carrier; the seller still pays carriage and insurance to the named destination

name: Delivered at Place
risk_transfer_point: At the named destination, on the arriving transport, ready for unloading

name: Delivered at Place Unloaded
risk_transfer_point: At the named destination, once unloaded

name: Delivered Duty Paid
risk_transfer_point: At the named destination, ready for unloading and cleared for import

name: Free Alongside Ship
risk_transfer_point: Alongside the vessel at the named port of shipment

name: Free On Board
risk_transfer_point: On board the vessel at the named port of shipment

name: Cost and Freight
risk_transfer_point: On board the vessel at the port of shipment; the seller still pays freight to the named port of destination

name: Cost, Insurance and Freight
risk_transfer_point: On board the vessel at the port of shipment; the seller still pays freight and insurance to the named port of destination
